Current_Implementation: JWT tokens stored in secure cookie / localStorage with role payload
Vulnerability_Or_Gap: JWT refresh token rotation must be enforced on mobile network switching to prevent session hijack
Remediation_Plan: Enable Supabase autoRefreshToken and enforce 15-minute access token lifespan with secure httpOnly cookies.

Vulnerability_Or_Gap: Frontend role checks must always be backed by server-side RPC authorization
Remediation_Plan: Every Express admin API route (/api/admin/*) enforces requireAdminRole middleware checking service_role or admin claims.

Vulnerability_Or_Gap: Unauthenticated direct table queries must return empty result sets rather than schema leaks
Remediation_Plan: ALTER TABLE public.bookings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY with strict RESTRICTIVE policies for non-admin tokens.

Current_Implementation: server.ts masks keys (replace(/:([^:@]+)@/, ':••••••••@')); frontend never receives unmasked credentials
Vulnerability_Or_Gap: Developers must ensure no raw .env credentials are compiled into client JS bundle
Remediation_Plan: Strict separation: only VITE_ prefixed vars exposed to client; all database passwords and partner secrets remain on server.

Current_Implementation: Razorpay webhook validates HMAC SHA256 signature against RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Vulnerability_Or_Gap: Unsigned replay attacks could attempt to mark unpaid reservations as confirmed
Remediation_Plan: Strict HMAC signature validation in server.ts /api/payments/webhook before updating payment_transactions table.

Current_Implementation: QRScannerModal decodes Base64 encoded payload with sha256 checksum and digital signature
Vulnerability_Or_Gap: Screenshots of revoked or cancelled boarding passes must be instantly rejected at gates
Remediation_Plan: Optical QR scanner queries backend revocation list and validates cryptographic ticket nonce before admitting passenger.

Current_Implementation: CSV generator escapes RFC 4180 inputs and omits backend underwriting algorithms and API keys
Vulnerability_Or_Gap: Potential CSV injection via crafted customer name fields containing =cmd|' /C ...'!A0
Remediation_Plan: All cell outputs sanitized with escapeCsvCell; leading arithmetic operators (=, +, -, @) safely neutralised.

Current_Implementation: Executes queries via parameterized connection pool; dangerous DROP DATABASE commands filtered
Vulnerability_Or_Gap: Arbitrary SQL studio could be abused if super_admin session is compromised
Remediation_Plan: Enforce read-only transaction mode (SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY) for non-super-admin queries and maintain immutable audit log in api_logs.
